Huckleberry is your all-in-one baby tracker and parenting partner, trusted by 5+ million families worldwide, from your first contraction to your baby's first steps. Our award-winning baby tracker app helps new parents track baby sleep, feeding, and growth with expert guidance at every stage. Backed by a team of pediatric experts, Huckleberry supports every family's journey, as a maternity app through the late stages of pregnancy, a newborn tracker in the early days, a baby sleep tracker, and solid foods log as your child grows. We turn guesswork into confidence, one stage at a time. CONTRACTION TIMER Time contractions with one tap. Track duration, intensity, and frequency. The first tool in your Huckleberry journey, built for expecting parents preparing for a newborn. SWEETSPOT®: YOUR SLEEP TIMING COMPANION A most-loved feature that predicts your baby's ideal nap and sleep times with remarkable accuracy. No more guessing about wake windows or watching for tired cues. SweetSpot® learns your child's unique rhythms to suggest optimal sleep schedules. TRACK GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT Our baby growth tracker helps you follow your child's development over time. From breastfeeding or bottle feeding to diapers and first foods, our baby tracker gives you peace of mind. See trends at a glance and share them easily with your pediatrician. BERRY: 24/7 PARENTING GUIDANCE 24/7 instant parenting backup that adapts to what you need, when you need it. Using expert-vetted and contextually aware AI-powered guidance, Berry works through the messiness of parenting with you. From sleep regressions to growth questions to "is this normal?" You always have backup. STARTING SOLIDS Confidently introduce new foods, whether it's purees, baby-led weaning, or both. Track allergens and note any sensitivities or reactions. Build a list of foods your baby's tried, what they liked (or didn't!), and get ideas for what to offer next. Get age-appropriate tips to safely serve common foods as purees or baby-led weaning. FREE APP FEATURES • Contraction timer for labor prep • Solids tracking: allergens, reactions, food ideas, and serving tips • One-touch tracker for sleep, diaper changes, feedings, pumping, growth, milestones, weight, potty training, activities, and medicine • Complete breastfeeding timer with tracking for both sides • Sleep summaries, history, and averages • Track multiple children with individual profiles • Reminders for medication, feedings, and more • Sync with multiple caregivers across devices PLUS MEMBERSHIP • All free features, and • SweetSpot®: predicts ideal wake windows and sleep times (2+ months) • Schedule Creator: age-appropriate sleep schedules • Insights: data-driven tips and miniplans for sleep, feeding, solids, and growth (0–18 months) • Enhanced Reports: discover your child's growth, sleep, and feeding trends • AI Logging: track your day through text, voice, or photo PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP • Everything in Plus, and • Berry: 24/7 guidance with our expert-vetted AI chat • Custom Sleep Plans: expert-designed sleep training plans, with regular check-ins as your baby grows GENTLE, EVIDENCE-BASED APPROACH Our sleep guidance never requires "crying it out." We blend trusted sleep science with gentle, family-centered solutions that respect your parenting style and fit your baby's unique wake windows, growth, and sleep regressions. AWARD-WINNING RESULTS Huckleberry ranked #1 in the iOS medical category globally. We help families across 179 countries achieve better sleep. Up to 93% of families using our baby sleep solutions report improved sleep patterns. Whether you're expecting, tracking your newborn's development, navigating a sleep regression, starting solids, or tackling toddler milestones, Huckleberry gives your family the tools and guidance to flourish at every stage.   • Editors’ Choice

  • The best!
    10/25/2025
    Lareina Star

    I really love this app! I got this app after having my first baby and constantly getting questions by health care professionals. “How many wet diapers has she had?” “When is the last time she ate?” “How long did she sleep?” All very important questions and all very overwhelming after having a baby. The next doctor’s appointment after downloading this app, I simply just showed them the data. After getting past the newborn phase, I felt more confident in my answers but still unsure about other aspects (such as a sleep routine). I continued to use this app like normal after the free trial ended and then around 2 1/2 months, I decided to purchase the membership and I am so glad I did! It gives information about sleep, wake windows, and soooo many other things in an easily readable format. It provides direction and adds flexibility to our schedule. My baby is 4 months now so her wake windows are getting longer. Her sleep signs can be pretty confusing now too. With this app, I know about how much time I have before she’s going to get sleepy and need a nap again. I love that multiple caretakers can use the same account. It has made the transition from one to another super easy because the next person can just look at the data and see how long she’s been asleep or when she’s due for another nap. I also love that you can log multiple things (medicine, solids, diaper changes, etc.) This app has been so great!

  • Definitely a good app.
    10/27/2023
    sunnysteph_o

    This app was recommended to me as a first time Mom with a cryptic pregnancy since I had no time to prepare for my baby, and it is incredibly useful to feel like I don’t have to remember everything when it comes to when I last changed his diaper or fed him, but I will say the one downside to this app, to no fault of its own, is that as a Mom whole is already struggling to balance so many things at once, I’ve found myself obsessing over when I forget to log something immediately or if the app doesn’t layout schedules properly. For an example, it will tell me in one tab how many feedings there have been for the day. In another where I can view the week schedule, it’ll break down my entries and for some reason it has separated one feeding session into two depending on how long our session was, making me think that from the other tab I have fed him more times that I actually have. It’s a bit confusing and I found myself trying to figure out why it has these weird quirks to the point that I looked down at my baby and took a big breath, realizing that it was really not the priority 😆 Once again, an excellent app when it comes to struggling to keep track of so much, but if you find yourself being prone to over stressing about everything, it would give you some peace of mind to try it but also see how you do without it. I’ve enjoyed more just listening to and learning from my baby and his habits naturally and creating my own habits off of his!

    Developer Response

    Hi there, Thank you for your positive review! We are so glad you are experiencing the magic of Huckleberry! We'd love to understand how we can improve and earn a better rating! Let us know at support@huckleberry-labs.com. We will look forward to hearing from you!

  • First time parents to easy newborn AND STILL couldn’t do without this app!
    03/23/2023
    AlwaysAMarketer

    The world of choice can be exciting, but also overwhelming. How do you know you’re really getting the best of what’s out there? As first-time parents, we didn’t know this beforehand but learned PRETTY QUICKLY, the days blend into night and the nights blend into days. Certain habits like feeding and burping, become so reflex you almost don’t remember if you are thinking about 5 min ago or yesterday. When you tag out for a nap and your partner/friend/caregiver tags in for baby time and there’s a “shift change”, it’s a GAMECHANGER to know what happened. Basically, you’re ABSOLUTELY going to want to track patterns over time. And time goes quick. Consider this a mini “medical record” for your baby, a wellness diary. Would say more but my 3.5 moth old just woke up from morning nap and it’s time to go! GET THIS APP, you’ll be so happy to have a record of what’s going on with your baby so you can anticipate what’s coming next. Biggest use case: it might SEEM like they haven’t slept enough / eaten enough / any other activity you’re tracking, but lo and behold when you check the app, you can demystify that and actually see that your baby HAS done enough of that (or not - and then quickly fix). This is EASILY ACCESSIBLE DATA that’s actually super useful, instead of data just for data’s sake. Compare ratios of breast milk to formula on a daily or weekly, so many benefits to huckleberry. Simplify your life with this app, so you can enjoy your baby :)

  • Our biggest solids upgrade yet: faster logging, smarter tracking, and serving tips for every first bite. - Log in seconds: find foods fast with recents, popular picks, and search. - Track each food: add a reaction, note, and photo to every food. - Allergy tracking: log symptoms and see a clear allergy report to share with your pediatrician. - See their progress: know how many times your little one has tried each food. - Fresh ideas: get suggestions for new foods to try. - How to Serve guides: safe, age-based prep tips for every food. - Readiness check: a gentle guide for babies under 6 months.

    v0.9.313 4d ago

  • - Fixed an issue that could unexpectedly sign some families out of their accounts. - The app now handles daylight saving changes correctly, including AEDT. SweetSpot also no longer adds an extra hour of night sleep on the morning the clocks spring forward. - Apple Watch: switching between ml and oz no longer doubles the amount, and saving and syncing are more reliable. - The Tummy Time timer stays accurate while your screen is off. - Reminder times now show in a consistent format. - If Apple sign-in fails, you can now sign in or sign up with email and password right after. - Opening the app on a weak or missing connection no longer sends you back to the welcome screen. - In families with more than one child, Berry’s replies now appear for the right child. - Other layout fixes and stability improvements.
